device_entry.description: 一款台式八通道数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电子信号波形。适合实验室中的电路调试、时序观察、波形测量和统计分析。
device_entry.description_en: A benchtop 8-channel digital oscilloscope for capturing, displaying, and analyzing electronic signal waveforms. It is used in laboratories for circuit debugging, timing observation, waveform measurement, and statistical analysis.
